From: Claire Novak <claire@novushealth.ai>

Cc: procurement@novushealth.ai

Subject: Mutual Success Charter — Week 0 & Timeline Kickstart

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile and cost controls you showed look promising for our inference use case. Procurement wanted me to loop you in so we can get a clear joint plan and a timeline to close the pilot.

Can you share a short Mutual Action / success charter template you typically use? Specifically we want:
- Week 0 checklist (tech contacts, infra access, test dataset delivery)
- Pilot acceptance criteria and gating items
- Suggested owners for each lane (security, infra, product)

If you have a lightweight GDoc or slide skeleton we can co-edit that would be ideal. We’d like to schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff to align stakeholders — Thursday or Friday this week would work.

I’ll copy procurement here so they can flag any timing constraints from our end.

Thanks,
Claire Novak
Head of ML Ops
Novus Health

Attachment: Novus-Internal-Timeline.xlsx (referenced)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Success Charter — Week 0 & Timeline Kickstart

Claire — great to hear, and thanks for the clear asks. I’ve sketched a compact Mutual Success Charter that hits the items you listed and left editable fields for owners and dates. High level:

- Objectives (what success looks like for Novus)
- Success criteria & acceptance gates (functional + perf + security checks)
- Week 0 checklist (access, minimal infra, test payloads, contact list)
- 3-week pilot timeline with key milestones and demos
- Risks & mitigation, procurement checklist (PO / SOW path)

I pushed a starter GDoc you can co-edit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2bNovusMAP
(attachment stub: Novus_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You drop initial stakeholder names into the Owners table in the doc
2) We run a 30-minute kickoff to confirm week 0 tasks and set the pilot demo date

Suggested kickoff: Thursday, May 21 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45m). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include our security lead and Ben for technical scope.

Ben — I copied you to add any tech gating items or a short slide timeline if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Adding a couple of practical items from the runtime side — quick notes and an editable slide timeline I put together:

Quick tech gating checklist (please add owners in the doc):
- VPN / VPC peering confirmation or VPN creds for private deployment
- Test dataset sample delivery (S3 link or secure upload)
- Baseline perf targets (p50/p95) and concurrency expectations
- Tokenization/IO format example + small smoke test script
- Security questionnaire kickoff (SOC2 scope)

I’ve attached a one-slide timeline (Close-Timeline-Week0.gslides) and a small Week0-Tech-Checklist.xlsx you can use to tick boxes during the kickoff.

Agenda suggestion for the kickoff (30m):
- 5m: Introductions & goals
- 10m: Walk the Week 0 checklist (owners + blockers)
- 10m: Confirm pilot acceptance gates and demo dates
- 5m: Procurement / next steps (PO / SOW path)

Claire — if you can populate the Owners column in the doc before the call that will speed things up. I’ll bring a short runbook and a script to show the quick perf check.

Ben Carter
